title: DeliveryLine Reviewer Verdict v1
description: Story 3d-2 (DD-3) — the advisory verdict an advisory-reviewer runner invocation emits over a WaitingForReview output artifact. Dedicated schema (NOT runner-result.v1) so the reviewer can carry pass/concern/fail + a rationale, leaving runner-result.v1 / ArtifactType / the frontend ArtifactView union untouched. The verdict is harvested into step_reviews (NOT the artifacts table); the backend computes model provenance and pins the reviewed-artifact FK, so this contract carries only what the runner authoritatively knows.

outcome.description: The advisory verdict. Mirrors the ReviewOutcome registry + the ck_step_reviews_outcome CHECK.

rationale.description: OPTIONAL free-text justification for the outcome. Redacted by the backend harvest before persistence to step_reviews (AC7); never echoed to logs. Absent/null is valid (a bare verdict).

summary.description: OPTIONAL one-line human summary of the review (parallels runner-result.v1 normalizedOutput.summary).

reviewerModelIdentity.description: OPTIONAL self-reported reviewer model identity (kind + image/version). The backend independently derives the authoritative reviewer identity from the reviewer execution for provenance/self-review (AC4); this is advisory only.

reviewedArtifactId.description: OPTIONAL echo of the reviewed artifact's public id (read from the bundle artifactReferences). The backend re-derives the reviewed artifact + version from the run to pin the step_reviews composite FK (it never trusts a runner-supplied FK); this echo is advisory/diagnostic only.

failureCategory.description: OPTIONAL — a runner-self-reported failure (parallels runner-result.v1). When present and non-blank, the backend records the reviewer execution failed (graceful degrade, AC6) and writes NO verdict. Constrained to the FailureCategory wire values a reviewer can authoritatively self-report (provider/timeout/exit faults); backend-assigned categories (late/duplicate/secret-leak/orphan) are not runner-emittable and are excluded so a malformed taxonomy is rejected at the contract layer rather than silently collapsing to runner_contract_violation.
